---
title: "Explore: Household Debt & Policy Effectiveness"
title-block-banner: true
toc: false
---

<p style="text-align: justify;">
Two of my papers in <em>Macroeconomic Dynamics</em> reach a striking pair of conclusions: <strong>fiscal stimulus works better when households carry little debt, while rate cuts hit harder — but fade faster — when they carry a lot</strong>. Use the controls below to switch between the two policies and across countries, and watch how the level of household debt changes the response of output.
</p>

```{=html}
<style>
.viz-root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --surface-1: #ffffff;
  --page: #f9f6ef;
  --ink-1: #0b0b0b;
  --ink-2: #52514e;
  --muted: #898781;
  --grid: #e1e0d9;
  --baseline: #c3c2b7;
  --low: #2a78d6;   /* low household debt */
  --high: #a33a2a;  /* high household debt (site accent) */
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(11,11,11,0.10);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
}
.viz-root * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.viz-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.9rem; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.viz-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--grid); border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; }
.viz-seg button {
  border: none; background: transparent; padding: 0.42rem 0.85rem; font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
}
.viz-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #7a2318; color: #f5efe6; font-weight: 600; }
.viz-controls select {
  font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; color: var(--ink-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--grid); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-1);
}
.viz-tiles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.8rem; margin: 0.7rem 0 0.3rem; }
.viz-tile { flex: 1 1 160px; background: var(--page); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; }
.viz-tile .t-label { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem;}
.viz-tile .t-value { font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-1); line-height: 1.2; }
.viz-tile .t-sub { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.chip { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:3px; }
.viz-chart-wrap { position: relative; }
.viz-tooltip {
  position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: var(--ink-1); color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 7px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.1s;
  white-space: nowrap; z-index: 5;
}
.viz-note { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 0.6rem; line-height: 1.45; }
.viz-root details { margin-top: 0.5rem; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 0; }
.viz-root details summary { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #2c7be5; }
.viz-root table { font-size: 0.85rem; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.viz-root th, .viz-root td { padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.viz-root th:first-child, .viz-root td:first-child { text-align: left; }
</style>

<div class="viz-root" id="hd-explorer">
  <div class="viz-controls" role="group" aria-label="Explorer controls">
    <span class="viz-seg" id="policy-seg">
      <button type="button" aria-pressed="true" data-policy="fiscal">Government spending ↑</button>
      <button type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-policy="monetary">Interest rate cut</button>
    </span>
    <select id="country-sel" aria-label="Country">
      <option value="US" selected>United States</option>
      <option value="AUS">Australia</option>
      <option value="NOR">Norway</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="viz-tiles">
    <div class="viz-tile">
      <div class="t-label"><span class="chip" style="background:var(--low)"></span> Low household debt</div>
      <div class="t-value" id="tile-low">—</div>
      <div class="t-sub">output response on impact</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-tile">
      <div class="t-label"><span class="chip" style="background:var(--high)"></span> High household debt</div>
      <div class="t-value" id="tile-high">—</div>
      <div class="t-sub">output response on impact</div>
    </div>
    <div class="viz-tile">
      <div class="t-label">Published estimate</div>
      <div class="t-value" id="tile-diff">—</div>
      <div class="t-sub" id="tile-diff-sub">difference on impact</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="viz-chart-wrap">
    <svg id="hd-svg" viewBox="0 0 820 400" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Stylised output response to a policy shock under low versus high household debt"></svg>
    <div class="viz-tooltip" id="hd-tip"></div>
  </div>

  <details>
    <summary>View as table</summary>
    <table id="hd-table"><thead><tr><th>Quarter</th><th>Low debt (% of GDP)</th><th>High debt (% of GDP)</th></tr></thead><tbody></tbody></table>
  </details>

  <p class="viz-note" id="hd-note"></p>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const svg = document.getElementById('hd-svg');
  const tip = document.getElementById('hd-tip');
  const Q = 13; // quarters 0..12

  // Stylised response paths anchored to published point estimates.
  const P = {
    fiscal: {
      base: 0.55, tauLow: 3.4, tauHigh: 3.0,
      diff: { US: 0.79, AUS: 0.70, NOR: 0.61 },   // multiplier larger under LOW debt (on impact)
      note: 'Stylised illustration anchored to point estimates in Zurita et al., “Does household debt affect the size of the fiscal multiplier?”, <i>Macroeconomic Dynamics</i> (2024): on impact, the fiscal multiplier is 0.70, 0.61 and 0.79 (% of GDP) larger in Australia, Norway and the US when the expansion occurs in a low household-debt period. Paths between the published impact estimates are illustrative, not model output.',
      diffLabel: c => `larger under <b>low</b> debt`,
      strongerUnder: 'low'
    },
    monetary: {
      base: 0.20, tauLow: 4.2, tauHigh: 2.6,
      diff: { US: 0.06, NOR: 0.06, AUS: 0.04 },   // stimulus larger under HIGH debt (on impact); less persistent
      note: 'Stylised illustration anchored to “Does household debt affect the transmission mechanism of monetary policy?” (forthcoming, <i>Macroeconomic Dynamics</i>): the short-run effect of a rate cut is generally stronger under high household debt — on impact about 0.06% of GDP larger in Norway and the US — but high debt reduces the persistence of the stimulus over quarters 4–8. Australia is shown with an illustrative smaller differential. Paths are illustrative, not model output.',
      diffLabel: c => `larger under <b>high</b> debt`,
      strongerUnder: 'high'
    }
  };

  let policy = 'fiscal', country = 'US';

  function series(impact, tau){
    const out = [];
    for (let t = 0; t < Q; t++) out.push(impact * (1 + 0.35*t/tau) * Math.exp(-t/tau));
    return out;
  }
  function data(){
    const p = P[policy], d = p.diff[country];
    const low  = p.strongerUnder === 'low'  ? p.base + d : p.base;
    const high = p.strongerUnder === 'high' ? p.base + d : p.base;
    return { low: series(low, p.tauLow), high: series(high, p.tauHigh), p, d };
  }

  const M = {l: 56, r: 130, t: 24, b: 44}, W = 820, H = 400;
  const plotW = W - M.l - M.r, plotH = H - M.t - M.b;

  function draw(){
    const {low, high, p, d} = data();
    const ymax = Math.max(...low, ...high) * 1.15;
    const x = t => M.l + plotW * t / (Q - 1);
    const y = v => M.t + plotH * (1 - v / ymax);
    svg.innerHTML = '';

    // gridlines + y labels
    for (let g = 0; g <= 4; g++){
      const val = ymax * g / 4, gy = y(val);
      const line = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'line');
      line.setAttribute('x1', M.l); line.setAttribute('x2', W - M.r);
      line.setAttribute('y1', gy); line.setAttribute('y2', gy);
      line.setAttribute('stroke', g === 0 ? '#c3c2b7' : '#e1e0d9');
      line.setAttribute('stroke-width', 1);
      svg.appendChild(line);
      const lbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'text');
      lbl.setAttribute('x', M.l - 8); lbl.setAttribute('y', gy + 4);
      lbl.setAttribute('text-anchor','end'); lbl.setAttribute('font-size','12');
      lbl.setAttribute('fill','#898781');
      lbl.textContent = val.toFixed(2);
      svg.appendChild(lbl);
    }
    // x labels
    for (let t = 0; t < Q; t += 2){
      const lbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'text');
      lbl.setAttribute('x', x(t)); lbl.setAttribute('y', H - M.b + 20);
      lbl.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); lbl.setAttribute('font-size','12');
      lbl.setAttribute('fill','#898781');
      lbl.textContent = t;
      svg.appendChild(lbl);
    }
    const xt = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'text');
    xt.setAttribute('x', M.l + plotW/2); xt.setAttribute('y', H - 6);
    xt.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); xt.setAttribute('font-size','12.5');
    xt.setAttribute('fill','#52514e');
    xt.textContent = 'Quarters after the policy shock';
    svg.appendChild(xt);
    const yt = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'text');
    yt.setAttribute('transform', `translate(14 ${M.t + plotH/2}) rotate(-90)`);
    yt.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle'); yt.setAttribute('font-size','12.5');
    yt.setAttribute('fill','#52514e');
    yt.textContent = 'Output response (% of GDP)';
    svg.appendChild(yt);

    // series
    const colors = { low: getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('hd-explorer')).getPropertyValue('--low').trim(),
                     high: getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('hd-explorer')).getPropertyValue('--high').trim() };
    const names = { low: 'Low debt', high: 'High debt' };
    // compute label positions with collision avoidance
    let yLow = y(low[Q-1]), yHigh = y(high[Q-1]);
    if (Math.abs(yLow - yHigh) < 18){
      const mid = (yLow + yHigh) / 2;
      if (yLow <= yHigh){ yLow = mid - 9; yHigh = mid + 9; } else { yLow = mid + 9; yHigh = mid - 9; }
    }
    const labelY = { low: yLow, high: yHigh };
    for (const key of ['low','high']){
      const s = key === 'low' ? low : high;
      const path = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'path');
      path.setAttribute('d', s.map((v,t) => (t?'L':'M') + x(t) + ' ' + y(v)).join(' '));
      path.setAttribute('fill','none');
      path.setAttribute('stroke', colors[key]);
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width', 2);
      path.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');
      svg.appendChild(path);
      // direct label at line end (collision-adjusted)
      const lbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'text');
      lbl.setAttribute('x', x(Q-1) + 10); lbl.setAttribute('y', labelY[key] + 4);
      lbl.setAttribute('font-size','12.5'); lbl.setAttribute('font-weight','600');
      lbl.setAttribute('fill', colors[key]);
      lbl.textContent = names[key];
      svg.appendChild(lbl);
    }

    // hover layer
    const hoverDots = ['low','high'].map(key => {
      const c = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'circle');
      c.setAttribute('r', 4.5); c.setAttribute('fill', colors[key]);
      c.setAttribute('stroke', '#ffffff'); c.setAttribute('stroke-width', 2);
      c.setAttribute('opacity', 0);
      svg.appendChild(c); return c;
    });
    const cross = document.createElementNS(svgNS,'line');
    cross.setAttribute('stroke','#c3c2b7'); cross.setAttribute('stroke-width',1);
    cross.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','3 3'); cross.setAttribute('opacity',0);
    cross.setAttribute('y1', M.t); cross.setAttribute('y2', H - M.b);
    svg.appendChild(cross);

    svg.onmousemove = e => {
      const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = (e.clientX - r.left) * (W / r.width);
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(Q-1, Math.round((mx - M.l) / plotW * (Q-1))));
      cross.setAttribute('x1', x(t)); cross.setAttribute('x2', x(t)); cross.setAttribute('opacity',1);
      hoverDots[0].setAttribute('cx', x(t)); hoverDots[0].setAttribute('cy', y(low[t])); hoverDots[0].setAttribute('opacity',1);
      hoverDots[1].setAttribute('cx', x(t)); hoverDots[1].setAttribute('cy', y(high[t])); hoverDots[1].setAttribute('opacity',1);
      tip.style.opacity = 1;
      tip.innerHTML = `<b>Quarter ${t}</b><br>Low debt: ${low[t].toFixed(2)}% · High debt: ${high[t].toFixed(2)}%`;
      const wrap = svg.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      tip.style.left = Math.min(e.clientX - wrap.left + 14, wrap.width - 190) + 'px';
      tip.style.top  = (e.clientY - wrap.top - 10) + 'px';
    };
    svg.onmouseleave = () => {
      tip.style.opacity = 0; cross.setAttribute('opacity',0);
      hoverDots.forEach(d => d.setAttribute('opacity',0));
    };

    // tiles, note, table
    document.getElementById('tile-low').textContent  = low[0].toFixed(2) + '%';
    document.getElementById('tile-high').textContent = high[0].toFixed(2) + '%';
    document.getElementById('tile-diff').textContent = (policy==='fiscal' ? '+' : '+') + d.toFixed(2) + ' pp';
    document.getElementById('tile-diff-sub').innerHTML = p.diffLabel(country);
    document.getElementById('hd-note').innerHTML = p.note;
    const tb = document.querySelector('#hd-table tbody');
    tb.innerHTML = '';
    for (let t = 0; t < Q; t++){
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `<td>${t}</td><td>${low[t].toFixed(3)}</td><td>${high[t].toFixed(3)}</td>`;
      tb.appendChild(tr);
    }
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('#policy-seg button').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('#policy-seg button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'));
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');
      policy = b.dataset.policy; draw();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('country-sel').addEventListener('change', e => { country = e.target.value; draw(); });
  draw();
})();
</script>

```

<p style="text-align: justify;">
The underlying research: [Does household debt affect the size of the fiscal multiplier?](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/macroeconomic-dynamics/article/does-household-debt-affect-the-size-of-the-fiscal-multiplier/E0085C862359FAD3151EAB5ED42606E7) (<em>Macroeconomic Dynamics</em>, 2024) and [Does household debt affect the transmission mechanism of monetary policy?](research.qmd) (forthcoming, <em>Macroeconomic Dynamics</em>). For what these results mean in practice, see the summaries on the [Research](research.qmd) page — and if your institution needs this kind of analysis, see [Consulting & Policy](consulting.qmd).
</p>
